methodology.presence: Number of sampled return records with a food / sampled return records from meals serving that food.
methodology.rice_extent: Synthetic reviewer category, not a volume or weight measurement.
methodology.coverage: 40 fictional sampled returns / 200 fictional meals per session; convenience sample.
methodology.weight: No scale readings. All leftover weights are unknown.
methodology.recommendation: Repeated rice leftovers motivate a controlled portion trial; taste, menu, selection and service timing are alternative explanations.
